resources.string: Real hardware features of your device
Sub-GHz RF (315/433/868/915 MHz) is not available in most phones. Use an external radio bridge such as ESP32 + CC1101.
Support for contactless card and tag operations.
Host Card Emulation for compatible scenarios.
IR transmit support when the device has Consumer IR hardware.
Wireless communication with external bridge hardware.
Ability to connect external adapters and modules.
A separate radio bridge is usually required for low-frequency RF tasks.
Practical conclusion: direct RF transmission on most Android phones is limited. Use phone-native features when present, and connect external hardware for full Flipper-like RF workflows.
